incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 429s + 502s affecting /v1/chat-stream in us-east-1. Error budget breached, paging primary.

Jonah Li: I'm grabbing this one. Primary=Jonah Li, Secondary=Priya Raman. Bridge: https://meet.redwood.example/bridges/6301112222

Jonah Li: Summary: Clients streaming chat requests are seeing intermittent 502s from the edge and increased 429 rate from edge-rate-limiter. Root cause appears to be a surge of malformed keepalive pings from a subset of clients leading to connection churn on edge proxies -> downstream auth-cache saturation. Customer impact: degraded streaming for ~3% of customers, several growers reporting reconnect loops.

Priya Raman: Observed spike in `edge_conn_reset` and `authcache_miss_rate` in logs. A specific host group `edge-proxy-az-a` shows most resets. Any infra actions started?

Nisha Patel: I restarted two edge-proxy pods in az-a last cycle (02:05 UTC) which temporarily reduced resets. Also applied a temporary rule to reject `keepalive: true` with path `/healthz` (weird clients). Patch: netfilter/630111-rm-healthz-keepalive.

Jonah Li: Good. I set temporary edge-rate-limit override for streaming requests from 1000rps -> 600rps for us-east streaming route at 02:12 UTC to curb retries. Also enabled circuit breaker for auth-cache calls with `max_conns=200` to avoid head-of-line blocking.

Priya Raman: What should next oncall watch for? any scripts/commands to run?

Jonah Li: Handoff checklist/commands for next oncall:
```bash
# edge proxy health
kubectl -n edge get pods -l role=edge-proxy -o wide
# tail edge proxy logs
kubectl -n edge logs -l role=edge-proxy -c proxy --since=15m | grep "conn_reset" | tail -n 200
# auth-cache metrics
curl -s http://metrics.internal/metrics | grep authcache
# check edge rate limit overrides
curl -s https://control-plane/internal/rateoverrides/us-east | jq .
```
Runbook references:
- https://redwood.example.com/ops/runbooks/edge-proxy-troubleshoot
- https://redwood.example.com/ops/playbooks/streaming-fallback

Jonah Li: Actions executed so far (timeline):
- 02:03 UTC: Pager fired.
- 02:05 UTC: Nisha restarted two edge-proxy pods in az-a.
- 02:12 UTC: applied edge-rate-limit override for streaming route.
- 02:18 UTC: enabled auth-cache circuit breaker and applied keepalive reject rule.
- 02:25 UTC: routing: 10% of streaming traffic cut to us-east-secondary region as fallback for heavy customers.

Priya Raman: I'll monitor customer support channel and coordinate degraded-mode offers. If 502s persist >10m at >5% we should run autoscaler policy on auth-cache: scale +3 and open infra pager.

Jonah Li: ACTIONS for incoming oncall (ACTIONABLE):
1) Monitor 5m rolling 502 rate and 429 rate. If combined error rate >6% for 10m -> scale auth-cache +3, notify infra.
2) If edge conn resets >100/min specifically on any edge-proxy host -> cordon that node and force-roll the edge-proxy daemonset on it.
3) If client retries appear to be from a specific customer (use `x-rw-client-id`) -> apply client-level throttle and notify CS to coordinate mitigation.
4) Prepare to flip streaming to polling fallback for affected customers (runbook link above).

Nisha Patel: I'll leave monitoring dashboards pinned and keep an eye on the `keepalive` reject rule metrics. Note: revert plan is to remove the rule if tail latencies increase for non-streaming requests by >150ms.

SRE-Bridge Bot: Bridge created: https://meet.redwood.example/bridges/6301112222. Participants: Jonah Li, Priya Raman, Nisha Patel.

Priya Raman: I'll be primary from 04:00 UTC. I'll check the `authcache_miss_rate` every 5m and post a status update every 20 minutes. If the override doesn't bring 429s down to <2% in 15m I'll escalate.

Jonah Li: Added customer list to thread: beta-chat (prod), dataflow-inc (staging), widget-co (prod). Beta-chat has opened ticket #CS-8509.

Priya Raman: A couple quick commands I'll use for escalation:
- `python tools/kv_inspect.py --target auth-cache --since 10m` to show hot keys
- `kubectl -n infra scale deployment auth-cache --replicas=$(($(kubectl -n infra get deploy auth-cache -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}')+3))` to scale

incident-bot: Pager suppressed to secondary at 02:45 UTC (auto-suppression). Note: alert thresholds remain active.

Jonah Li: Leaving handoff note: continue watch for 60m after takeover. If anything new occurs please Ping @oncall immediately and drop a brief update in this thread. I'll keep CS-8509 annotated with the mitigation steps.

Priya Raman: Taking over at 04:00 UTC. I'll post updates at 04:20 UTC and 04:40 UTC unless something urgent happens. :hourglass:
